Write the agent documents: an AGENTS.md block and a skill

Source: R/use-agent-docs.R
use_agent_docs.Rd

Writes, under the project root, a block in AGENTS.md (created when absent) and the weft skill, that tell a coding agent the rules of a weft project: a failed claim is a finding to report, a check is never changed to make a render pass, a commit that removes constructs carries the Weft-Removed trailer, and values for one chapter go in dict_local.

Usage

use_agent_docs(path = ".", overwrite = FALSE, skills = "agents")

Arguments

path

A directory in the project.

overwrite

Replace a block or skill file weft wrote that has since been edited.

skills

The skills folders to write into: a character vector of preset names or folders relative to the project root. The default, "agents", writes .agents/skills alone. Claude Code reads .claude/skills and not .agents/skills, so Claude Code users pass skills = c("agents", "claude"), or install the plugin with /plugin marketplace add vorpalvorpal/weft. The presets are agents (.agents/skills), claude (.claude/skills), codex (.agents/skills), gemini (.gemini/skills), opencode (.opencode/skills), kimi (.kimi-code/skills) and cursor (.cursor/skills). An item with a / or starting with . is a folder; an absolute path or one with a .. part is an error. Folders that come to the same place are written once. character() writes the AGENTS.md block only. A weft-written copy in a preset folder that is not named, and is older than this weft, is not touched; the call says so and how to update it.

Value

The paths written, invisibly (character() when nothing changed): AGENTS.md first, then the skill files folder by folder in the order given.

Details

The skill is <folder>/weft/SKILL.md with references/syntax.md and references/reports.md beside it, written into each skills folder named by skills. The same texts go into every folder. agent_docs() prints the installed package's version of each.

The AGENTS.md block sits between <!-- weft:start ... --> and <!-- weft:end --> lines, appended after the file's last line with one blank line before it; the rest of the file is never touched. The start line and the last line of each skill file carry the weft version and a hash. Each file is judged alone: one weft wrote and nobody edited is replaced when its text would differ; an edited one is left as it is unless overwrite = TRUE; a file with no weft line is another author's and is never replaced. One copy being edited does not stop the others being written.

When CLAUDE.md exists and does not hold @AGENTS.md, or GEMINI.md exists and holds neither @AGENTS.md nor @./AGENTS.md, the call says to add that line; neither file is written. It says what it will write first. suppressMessages() silences it.
